primary_endpoint: Within-family Spearman rho of pre-solver structural predictor vs median PAR-2 over two original Kissat attempts; no dropping timeouts
source_family_permutation_test: 5000 shuffled hardness outcomes within each family, two-sided, across 4*3 family/feature tests; report BH q
transfer_primary_rule: Both Gini and CV negative in >=3/4 external families, and each family-stratified pooled rho negative with permutation p<0.05 and BH q<0.05 across all 3 predictors. The graph-coloring family is separately reported regardless.
flat_graph_coverage: All 40 seeded formulas counted even if solve timeout, no post-measurement selection
confidence: Exploratory observational transfer. Passing criteria is not causation or general NP hardness law.
safety: Never modify solver; verify archive hashes and formula CNF validity; accept only expected SAT or UNSAT labels; SAT witnesses checked, original Kissat UNSAT proof not checked independently.
prior_data_scope: Independent of earlier UUF250 structural discovery/confirmation, but historical whole-user usage beyond available manifests cannot be certified.
no_further_tuning: Thresholds, source sets, formulas and feature set locked before any cross-family timing.
